title: llm
summary: A personal repository of proof-of-concept scripts, including one that loads a CSV dataset and generates synthetic rows for comparison against the real data. It uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, fit on real data and sampled to produce synthetic records, with a SingleTableMetadata object to describe the schema.
